edges.reason: claimForInBatch executes the external _claimer.claimFor call during each loop iteration.
_claimer state variable supplies the target address for the external call.
claims.length determines the loop bound for i.
claims[i] is copied into the local claim variable.
loop index i selects which ClaimArgs element becomes claim.
fields of local claim are forwarded as arguments to _claimer.claimFor.
External call to _claimer can reenter claimForInBatch before the loop completes.
claimForInBatch contains the unchecked increment operation.
loop index i is incremented by unchecked ++i.
unchecked increment writes the updated value back to i.
after the external call, execution proceeds to the unchecked loop increment.
loop continues to the next iteration and may execute another external call.
